items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: During those times, they only had King Gordy's band... That's right, King Gordy. He's dead, but he, uh, in fact he used to have a band.

ctx.x: Did they have any little bands up there, of their own?

During those times, they only had King Gordy's band. King? King Gordy. King Gordy. That's right, King Gordy. He's dead, but he, uh, in fact he used to have a band. You know how I did, but they had, uh, these pick-up-ups, you know, like this. It was like he'd send out of town to get two of these bands, and then maybe he'd send out there, or maybe, uh, I'd say, to a man to get a band. Yeah, they were playing, see like that. Yes. So, that, that was, uh, the only band I know of Borgalusa, of those times. Mm-hmm. See,…
Did you ever know about Frank Wilson, out that way?
